User: In exactly 2 sentences, no bullet points, plain text only: what is the difference between RAM and a hard drive for a non-technical person?
Assistant:

RAM is your computer’s short-term memory that temporarily holds what you’re working on right now so it can be accessed very quickly, but it’s cleared when you turn the computer off. A hard drive is your computer’s long-term storage that keeps your files, programs, and photos saved even when the computer is turned off, but it is slower to access than RAM.
